paragraphs.text: Circu was the Dimir Guild Champion during the events of the Ravnica block .

Circu was a faithful servant of Szadek . As a lobotomist, those who knew or saw “too much” were dealt with by his scalpel. He was able to cut incriminating information out of the minds of his enemies, shaving out the brain tissue that would allow for recall of lost knowledge. His skillful work ensured that Dimir secrets remained unknown to others. In the event that someone was able to evoke selective recall, Circu and Szadek concocted a simple spell ( Glimpse the Unthinkable ) that purged knowledge with a broad, crude stroke and allowed its victim to see “the truth.”
